༄༅/ /yi dam drag po'i mngon rtogs rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i dbang bshad bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅ $!#$&// yi dam drag po'i mngon rtogs rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i dbang bshad bzhugs so//

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan snyam pa'i thugs bskyed kyis gsan 'tshal/ de yang spyir gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnam par 'joms par mdzad pa'i ye shes kyi khro bo chen po gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa zhig yin la 'di'i sgrub pa'i thabs mi 'dra ba rgyud sde bzhi po so so nas gsungs pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir phyag na rdo rje che ba bzhi'am dgu ru grags pa 'di rnams shin tu dar zhing byin rlabs bka' babs mchog dang ldan pa yin te/ de la phyag rdor mdo lugs mdze gsos kyi che ba ni mdo sngags gnyis kyi zlas dbye ba'i mdo ma yin gyi/ gos sngon can gyi gzungs mdo la brten pas na de skad can grags shing*/ 'di bya rgyud kyi khong su gtogs/ sngon shin tu dar rgyas che yang deng sang 'di yi dbang rgyun ma chad tsam bzhugs pa lags/ 'byung po 'dul byed me dmigs kyi che ba ni/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud la brten pa ste spyod rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs/ ka) gos sngon can chos skyong gi che ba ni/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs ni/ 'di la rgyal chen rnam sras bka' sdod kyi tshul du yod pas zangs dkar lots+tsha ba'i chos skyong gi che bas bod yul khyab pa de kho na'o// phyag na rdo rje drag po rab khros klu 'dul gyi che ba ni bod 'dir 'gyur ba'i phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud chen po zhig yin pas so// 'khor lo chen po dbang gi che ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang dbang bzhi zhib rgyas su yod pas so// phyag rdor be con rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi che ba ni/

'di la rgya gzhung chen po brgyad yod par grags kyang deng sang dbang lung gi rgyun med do// u tsar+ya drag sngags kyi che ba ni/ rdo rje khros pa'i rgyud ces sde brgyad kyi srog snying drag sngags du ma yod pas de ltar grags la/ de ni phyag na rdo rjes slob dpon klu sgrub la gnang*/ des slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra la/ des tsan+d+ra go mi la/ des dharma rā dza la/ des slob dpon zangs gling pa la gnang*/ de ni 'khrungs yul zangs gling du sku 'khrungs pas mtshan de ltar grags/ zangs gling dang 'phags pa'i yul du 'gro don rgya che bar mdzad/ de nas bod du phyin na dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhes yi dam gyis lung bstan pa bzhin bod du phebs/ gzhags su khye'u'i ro gsar pa la 'pho ba grong 'jug mdzad de/ sku lus rnying pa bor/ gsar pa len par mdzad pas mtshan kor ni ru par grags/ des byang chub sems dpa' khams pa a seng la gnang*/ de nas nye bar brgyud de bod yul 'dir shin tu dar rgyas su gyur cing deng sang gi bar du yang byin rlabs kyi bka' babs mchog dang ldan par bzhugs pa lags/ kha) gtum po khyung gi che ba ni/ 'di gang la brten pa'i rgyud gsang ba mngon par bstan pa zhes bya ba yin zhing*/ 'di'i rgya gzhung slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams yin/ chos skor 'di rnams gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes slob dpon las kyi rdo rje la dngos su gnang*/ 'di ni chung ngu'i dus nam mkha' nas phyag na rdo rje sgrubs shig ces pa'i sgra byung nas bsgrubs pas/ phyag na rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs zhal bstan/ gdams pa gnang nas sgrub rten shing gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhig yod pas phrin las thams cad rdo rje des bsgrubs pas mtshan karma badz+ra zhes thog /khyad par du mtha' 'khob tu chos la dga' ba'i rgyal po zhig yod pa phyi rol la mos pa'i rgyal po stobs chen zhig dang g.yul sprad pas rang phyogs kyi rgyal po de ches pham pa'i skabs slob dpon 'dis sgrub rten gyi rdo rje de'i phyed tsam bstan pas dgra zla'i rgyal po'i dpung thams cad 'thor bar mdzad do// des slob dpon shing lo pa la gnang*/

de la slob dpon kar+ṇa pas zhus te pha mes kyis phog pa'i gser ril ba gang yod pa chom pos khyer bar bye ma'i 'dam du rdel dkar nag bcug pa snyab pa dang*/ snag tsha smyug gu shog bu gsum la sngags btab ste rkun po'i ming 'dri yong ba dang*/ chu mig tu lag pa bcug pas sbrul dang sbal pas 'dzin pa dang gsum yod pa'i rgyab ma byed par bshams pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pa zhig gis klu la rngan pa glud drangs nas rkun ma'i lag pa chur bcug pa klus ma bzung bas kar+ṇa pa khros te/ slob dpon shing lo pa la phyag na rdo rjes zhus te bsgrubs pas klu de skrag nas rkun ma ngos 'dzin ji lta bar byas/ des rang gi tsha bo ba la tsan+d+ra la gnang*/ de yang mi zhig sbrul gyis zin pa bya mo zhig gis byabs pas sbrul de shi/ mi de sos/ bya mo yang shi ba la sngags btab pas slar sos so// de la rje btsun ras chung pas gsan pa yin te/ ras chung pa dgung lo bco lnga tsam bzhes pa'i dus su/ snga sor nas phru slog mang po mdzad pas/ klu la phog thug mang du byung ba la brten/ snyun mdze drag po glo bur du byung ste shin tu 'o brgyal bar bzhugs pa/ rgya gar gyi a tsa ra gsum dang mjal/ de rnams kyis snying rje'i bsam pas/ rje btsun ras chung pa rgya gar du khrid de/ bla ma ba la tsan+d+ra'i drung du bskyal/ bla ma de ni nus mthu shin tu che/ skye bo kun gyis mthong bar mig gsum yod par grags/ rgya gar nub phyogs nags tshal chen po mi ma yin dang gcan gzan mang po yod pa'i gnas zhig tu rtswa yi spyil por sku gcer bur bzhugs shing nyam nga tsam yang med/ bla mas kyang thugs brtse bas gzigs te/ phyag rdor gtum po'i chos skor ras chung pa la gnang nas/ gnas de nyid du sgrub pa mdzad pas ring por ma lon par snyun mdze las yongs su grol/ de nas bod du phebs te chos skor 'di rnams dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin zhing de yang la stod cung pa'i sar sngags pa mang pos sbyin sreg byed cing yod par ras chung pas de la bstan pa'i gnas lugs kyi mgur bzhengs pas sngags pa gzhon pa zhig dad de phyag phyir 'brang bas zangs rir bsgrubs/

zangs ri ras par grags pa de la gnang ba sogs kyi lo rgyus ras chung pa de nyid kyi rnam thar na bzhugs pa ltar ro// 'di la sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor du byas pa la'ang phyi sgrub lha lnga'am/ nang sgrub lha bcu gsum mam/ gsang sgrub lha nyer gcig ma rnams su yod cing*/ dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs la/ gtum chen srung ba'i mkhar dang*/ gtum chung 'bar ma gnyis yod pa lags/ de lta bu'i phyag na rdo rje gtum po che chung gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma zangs ri ras pa sogs sbyor ro// ༈ 'byung 'dul gyi lo rgyus ni/ gong du bshad pa'i spyod pa'i rgyud kyi khong su gtogs pa la/ ka) zhes pa'i mtshams su/ 'di nas bshad pa'i lha'i rnam pa dang sngags mtshungs par rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nas kyang gsungs pa yin te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i gur 'byung po 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// dbang po sngon po lha yi 'od// phyag bzhi 'jigs byed chen po ste// mdzes pa'i khro bo'i lus can nyid// dbang ldan 'byung po mnan pa ste// g.yas pa rigs kyi bdag po nyid// lag pa g.yon pas seng lpags 'dzin// gnyis po dag gi phyag brgya sbyor// zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas yang dag gnas// cung zad mche bas 'jigs par byed// mgo bos phreng ba'i rgyan mchog ste// 'byung po 'dul ba 'grub par 'gyur// gnod sbyin du ma 'byung po dang*// gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang*// mi mo lha yi mdzes ma ni// sgrub pa po yis nges par 'grub// ces gsungs pa ste/ da lta'i rjes gnang zur bka'i 'byung 'dul 'di gtso bor rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la brten par mngon zhing*/ 'di yi brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a bha yā kā ra/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal rga lo/

rje dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ spom brag pa/ karma pak+shi/ gnyan ras/ rang byung zhabs/ g.yung ston pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ dbang rgyas/ yon tan dpal/ dkon mchog dpal/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ karma si tu/ rin chen 'od zer/ sangs rgyas grags/ rje chos kyi go cha/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje/ chos kyi dbang phyug /karma chags med/ dul mo chos rje/ chos kyi don grub/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed kyi bar du brgyud pa yin la/ gzhan yang rje snye mdo ba nas rang byung pa brgyud pa dang*/ bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra nas brgyud pa dang*/ lots+tsha ba blo brtan nas brgyud pa dang*/ kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i lugs srol rnams kyang mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha la 'dus shing*/ 'di yi nye brgyud me dbang ni phyag na rdo rjes dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal la dngos su gnang zhing*/ de nas paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan sogs nas jo nang tā ra nā tha'i bar du brgyud cing*/ de nas rim pas kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas la 'du ba yin no// zhes sbyar bar bya'o// ༈ rnam 'joms kyi lo rgyus ni/ bskal pa bzang po 'di'i sngon rol zhig nags tshal drwa ba can bya bar/ dge slong 'od zer snang zhes pa dka' thub dang*/ dka' spyad drag pos sgrub pa nyams su len par ni byed/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang bral ba zhig yod pa la/ phyag na rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bram ze'i khye'u zhig gis mngon shes kyis brtags pa las/ dge slong de'i tshul rigs nas yang dag pa'i lta ba la zhugs par bya ba'i phyir nags tshal der phyin to// dge slong gi bsam pa ci nags tshal 'di'i mtha' thams cad gcan gzan gdug pa ma rungs pa dag gi gang bas skye bo tha mal pa dag 'dir thar bar mi nus kyi/ nges par bdag la bar chad byed pa'i gdug pa can zhig 'dug go snyam ste/ seg shing de'i mgo bo la bsnun pas/ bram ze de srog dang bral ba'i gnas skabs la thug

/des dge slong la smras pa/ kho bo la 'di lta bu'i gnod pa ci'i phyir byed/ des smras pa/ kho bo la bar du se gcod pa byed pas so// bram zes smras pa/ kho bo ni de ltar ma yin te/ khyod ni yang dag pa'i lta ba la 'jug pa'i phyir 'dir 'ong ba yin/ ci ste kho bo khyod la gnod pa'i sems yod na/ khyod yun ring du 'tsho bar gyur cig /phan pa'i bsam pas 'dir 'ong ba bden na/ nga dang lhan cig khyod nyid kyang da lta 'chi bar gyur cig ces dmod pa bor bas de ma thag de gnyis ka shi/ de nas nam zhig na/ sngar gyi dge slong de stobs dang dbang thang shin tu che ba'i rgyal po log pa'i snying po zhes bya bar gyur/ sngar gyi bram ze de bram ze'i khye'u rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya bar gyur to// de'i tshe nam zhig tsam na rgyal po de'i srod kyi rmi lam na/ sdig pa ma smad lngas lus kyi smad kyi cha nas za bar rmis/ nam phyed tsam na gdon gyi rgyal po phur bu rkang gcig pa bya ba stod mi la smad phur bu'i dbal du yod pa'i gdon zhig dang 'phrad pas/ rgyal po nyid lus la bro nad chen pos btab bo// de'i tshe rgyal po chen po sde bzhi rgyal po nad kyis gzir ba la snying rje drag po skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po nad las thar ba'i phyir/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs gsung bar gsol ba btab pas/ ston pas lho phyogs ku sha'i tshal du rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs phan yon dang bcas pa gsungs nas// rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /ces gdul bya'i gtso bo yang rgyal po nyid la dgongs/ de nas rdo rje rnam 'joms gzungs/ bram ze'i khye'u rig pa 'dzin pa sogs skal ba dang ldan pa du mas rig sngags 'don bzhin pas gnas so// de nas rgyal po log pa'i snying pos nad 'di la thabs ji lta bus phan zhes bram ze mtshan mkhan rnams la dris pa las/ de rnams na re/ bram ze'i khye'u brgya lus la rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rgya mtsho la 'phangs na/

rgyal po bsnyun las grol bar 'gyur zer/ rgyal pos kyang de bzhin byed par sems te/ bram ze'i khye'u dgu bcu rtsa dgu brnyed/ gcig ma rnyed pas na/ bram ze'i khye'u rig pa 'dzin pas/ rgyal po nad las bskyab pa dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u de rnams 'jigs pa chen po de las bskyab phyir bram ze'i khye'u de dag gi khrod du phyin te/ nangs par khye'u rnams rgya mtsho la 'phang rgyu'i do nub rgyal po'i nye skor du mtshan thog thag rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs bton pas ghur+ṇa ghur+ṇa zhes pa'i sgra la sems rtsig tu gnas pa rna bar thos pa las byung ba de thob pas/ nad phal cher yang drag /nangs par blon po rnams bos te/ kho bo nad phal cher phan pa 'di/ bram ze'i khye'u rig pa 'dzin pas mtshan mo gzungs bton pa rna bar thos pa las byung ba de ji ltar yin/ bram ze'i khye'u la dris shig /ces bsgo ba ltar dris pas/ de ni rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs bya ba/ gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa'i gzungs sngags zab cing khyad par can yin pas/ 'di rgyal po'i snyan du gsol bas snyun phal cher dwangs pa yin/ slob dpon shrī singha bya ba spyan drangs te/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing*/ khrus mdzad na snyun mtha' dag las grol bar 'gyur zhes gsol bas/ rgyal po'i thugs su yang 'phrod de/ sngar gyi khye'u rnams rang gnas su btang*/ slob dpon spyan drangs te dbang bskur zhus shing sku khrus mdzad pas rgyal po snyun mtha' dag las grol lo// gzungs mdo 'di bod yul du rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus thon mi sam bha ṭas bod yig tu bsgyur zhes lo rgyus rnying pa 'ga' zhig na snang*/ 'on kyang dbang bskur ba sogs kyi lag len ma byung*/ phyis rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus/ dpal bsam yas kyi bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du sngags 'chang dharma kirtis rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi dkyil 'khor du rgyal po la dbang bskur zhing sgrub pa'i thabs bshad pa yin pas/

bod du dbang bskur byung ba'i thog ma yang de yin zhing*/ skye bo thams cad kyis gzungs mdo 'don pa sogs dar rgyas kyang shin tu che bar 'byung ba yin no// 'di la sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang*/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang*/ da lta'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa rnam 'joms ljang sngon 'di bla ma ba ri lots+tsha ba nas nye bar brgyud pa yin zhing*/ de nas rje btsun sa skya pa sogs sbyar ro// ༈ bi ma la'i lugs kyi rnam 'joms dkar po la mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang*/ da lam skabs su bab pa 'di ni/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis paṇa chen byi ma la mi dra'am bi ma la mi tra spyan drangs nas rdzogs pa chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos rgya mtsho lta bu bstsal ba'i khrod nas/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dkar po 'di yi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ bi ma la mi tra/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ lha dpal gyi ye shes/ sru legs pa'i sgron ma/ nā ro tshe 'byin/ gnur ston bla ma/ rgyal po ba lung pa/ bla ma dge 'dun 'bum/ ras pa ba/ rje rang byung rdo rje

sogs sbyar ro// ༈ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i lo rgyus ni/ de yang 'phags pa'i yul du paṇ+ḍi ta 'od byed 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bya ba la phan gang che gzigs pas/ phyi rol pa dang rtsod pa byas nas nang pa la btsud na phan che bar gzigs te/ mu stegs kyi ston pa rnams dang rtsod pa byas pas paṇ+ḍi ta de lan grangs mang por pham pas/ da rtsod pa byas pas ni phan thogs par mi 'dug sgrub pa kho na bya yis dgongs te/ mgron khang zhig tu dkon mchog gi rten bkram ste sgrub pa mdzad kyin yod pa'i skabs su sgo rdung ba zhig byung nas sgor gzigs pas/ rnal 'byor pa dkar seng nge ba zhig 'dug pa na re/ nga la tsha ba cig drangs dang khyed la phan thog bsam mi shes zer/ nang du spyan drangs nas bza' btung legs pa cig drangs/ 'bul ba mang du byas pas/ 'bul ba ye mi 'dod/ mu stegs las rtsod pa pham pa de khyod min ang gsungs/ yin lags zhus pas/ 'o na rje btsun mi g.yo ba dkar po sgrubs shig gsungs/ paṇ+ḍi ta des mi g.yo ba'i rten gyi drung du lto gos sogs yid la mi byed pa'i dam bca' byas nas bsgrubs pas zla ba phyed nas rje btsun mi g.yo bas zhal gzigs/ bka' rab 'byams thams cad thugs su chud/ mu stegs pa thams cad dang rtsod pas rgyal te nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la btsud/ des paṇa chen shākya shrī la gnang*/ des rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la gnang ba yin zhing de sgra tshad la ches mkhas pas mu stegs pa mang po btul bas mu stegs pa thams cad kyis bskrad las kyis bod du byon pa yin zhes gsungs/ des 'dul 'dzin byang sems sogs la'o// yang o tan+ta pū ri'i drung gi grong khyer a las ma dza zhes bya bar/ rgyal po dharma pā la'i mchod gnas paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya dang*/ rab byung stong phrag tsam bzhugs pa'i nang na dge tshul gcig blo shin tu rmongs par yod pas/

ri bo gho de shan bya bar/ ku sa li si ba mkhan la sgrub thabs 'di zhus nas bsgrubs pas zhag nyer gcig nas zhal mthong*/ zla ba gcig nas sgra tshad dang mngon pa sogs thugs su chud nas paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur/ rgyal po'i mchod gnas kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la bstod pa dang skyon brjod kyi tshigs bcad re re brtsams/ phyis bsnyen par rdzogs pas rat+na a ka ra bha drar grags/ mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rgyal byed gzhon nu zhes dbang phyug grub pas phyi nang gi grub mtha' thams cad la mkhas pa de la rgyal po dpang por bcol/ bstan pa rgyan du btsugs te brtsad pas lan bcu bzhir pham par byas te nang par btsud do// de lta bu'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ 'dul 'dzin byang sems nas/ lung gi dbang phyug /yon tan khri pa/ 'jigs med grags pa/ jo nang phyogs pa/ mkhan po g.yag pa/ 'dis mi g.yo ba dkar po rtag tu zhal gzigs/ bo dong 'jigs bral dang chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad skabs bo dong pas 'di pa'i dbu gdugs kyi steng nas mi g.yo ba gzigs pa byung*/ de nas kun mkhyen rong po/ rje btsun don yod pa/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ shangs ston/ rje don yod grub pa/ rje btsun grol mchog /rje rdo ring pa/ rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ rje btsun blo gros rnam rgyal/ chos rje ngag dbang phrin las/ chos rje kun bzang dbang po/ grub dbang kaḥthog pa chen po/ rje btsun sgrub rgyud shing rta/ rje btsun bstan pa'i nyin byed ces sogs sbyar ro// ༈ mi g.yo ba'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus su dge slong zhig bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug cing yod pa la/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bdag po bdud dga' rab dbang phyug mi nag rta nag gi rnam pa can/ dgu tshigs lta bu'i lam las byung nas bar chad rtsam pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje gtum po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/

bdud 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad tshar bcad cing zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan pa yin no// de nas khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo yin pas/ bdud kyi bar du gcod pa bzlog pa la lhag par bsngags pa yin no// 'di la mi g.yo ba bla na med pa'i rgyud ces bya ba yar klung lo ts+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba zhig yod pa yin la/ sgrub thabs kyang dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du mdzad pa mi g.yo bla med lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyun dang bcas pa dus phyis bar du rgyun ma chad par dar zhing deng sang bal yul du nang pa'i sngags pa rnams la dar rgyas su yod do// gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs kyang mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs/ mi g.yo dkar po/ bka' gdams lugs kyi mi g.yo ba/ mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa/ mi g.yo ba zhabs bzhi pa/ mi g.yo spre'u brgyad ma sogs sgrub thabs zur bka' khyad par can mang du bzhugs pa las/ mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs ni/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung slob dpon dze ta ris mdzad pa nyid yin te/ de yang dze ta ri pa shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur kyang*/ rgyal po'i sa dra ma lon pas yul sna tshogs su paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la rtsod pa dang*/ lha khang rnams la blta zhing mchod pa byed pa la sogs pa'i don du byed pa las/ lan cig nags gseb cig na lha khang zhig 'dug pa de la mchod pa 'bul du byon pa na mi g.yo ba'i sku shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dug pa gzigs te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku bya ba mthong na mi mthun pa med pa blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig dgos pa la/ srin po'i gzugs can 'di lta bu sangs rgyas kyi sku ma yin no snyam ma dad pa skyes te mchod pa mdzad 'phro bzhag /de'i nub mo mnal lam du/ rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho'i thugs ka nas khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sku dpag tu med pa spro bsdu mdzad pa zhig rmis/

mnal sad pa na/ thugs dgongs la sangs rgyas kyi sku gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa la/ ma dad pa skyes pas sdig pa chen po bsags snyam nas sngar gyi lha khang der mi g.yo ba'i sku la mchod pa phul zhing sdig bshags mdzad/ de'i nub de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ma dad pa byas pa'i sdig pa de tsam gyis dag par mi 'gyur gyi/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs rtsoms shig /des byang bar 'gyur zhes pa zhig rmis nas mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs 'di mdzad do// de lta bu'i bla ma brgyud pa sogs sbyar ro// ༈ sme brtsegs ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bya rgyud dpung bzang dang*/ sme brtsegs bstod pa'i rgyud las gsungs shing*/ bya rgyud las sgo drug tu bzhugs pa las rdo rje'i rigs yin/ de la yang rigs kyi gtso bo bdag po dang*/ rigs kyi sems dpa' sems ma/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya dang drug yod pa las/ 'di rigs kyi pho nya yin zhing*/ sngon drag po dbang phyug gis 'dzam gling lha gnas dang bcas pa dbang du byas pa'i tshe/ dpal phyag na rdo rje kho yi gnas su byon te/ u ma'i rtsar dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su mdzad de bzhugs pas dbang phyug nyid 'ongs te/ khyod nga yi gnas su ma 'dug cig zer ba na/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes khyod nga yi gnas su ma 'ongs shig gsungs kyang dbang phyug u ma la 'thab kyin 'gror ma 'dod pas/ phyag na rdo rje u ma'i lhums su zhugs te/ khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa sras kyi tshul du bltams ma thag /dbang phyug dang u ma khyur mid mdzad de rnam snang gi lam nas bton pas khong gnyis shin tu bred de srog snying phul zhes grags shing*/ sngags rnying ma'i lo rgyus rnams su rta phag yab yum gyis ru tra bsgral ba'i tshe sras kyi tshul du byon zhes pa dang yang gnad gcig go /'di ni mi gtsang ba'i zas dang gos kyi grib sogs gdon grib thams cad kyi gnyen por che/

bya ba yongs su bstan pa'i mdo las/ snyigs ma'i dus su sde 'khrugs pa byed pa'i sems can rnams dmyal bar skye gsungs pa'i gnyen por gang phan zhes dge bshes ston pas jo bor zhus pas/ de'i gnyen por 'di che'o zhes sme brtsegs ljang nag gi sgrub thabs 'di gnang ba yin zhing*/ sme brtsegs dud kha 'di rje btsun bir+wa pa'i lugs yin cing sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan yin cing bir+wa pas sa chen la dngos su gnang ba yang yin la ba ri lots+tsha nas rje btsun sa skya par brgyud pa yin zhing*/ de dag gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ sogs sbyar dgos/ ༈ sme brtsegs jo bo lugs la/ ljang nag gi sgrub thabs 'di gnang ba yin zhing*/ des na jo bo rje/ nag tsho lots+tsha ba/ lag sor ba shes rab 'bar sogs sbyar ro// ༈ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i lo rgyus ni/ bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zlog par byed pa khro bo bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sgrub thabs 'di ni gtso bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mas paṇa chen a bha yā ka ra la rjes su gnang ba yin zhing*/ de nas tsa mi lots+tsha ba sangs rgyas grags/ dpal rga lo/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po sogs sbyar/ ༈ rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi lo rgyus ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnams las rigs drug tu bshad pa'i rdo rje rgyal po ste/ don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi khro bo dpal rta yi rgyal por grags pa/ snga 'gyur bka' gter rnams las phyogs 'dir gsal zhing rgyas shos su bzhugs la/ sngar gyi gsar ma'i phyogs 'dir yang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi sogs las kyang gsungs shing*/ las kyi rigs ji bzhin par sgrub pa don yod grub pa rta yi rgyal po dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs su sgrub pa pad+ma dbang chen nam pad+ma mthar byed dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs su sgrub pa rdo rje khro bo rta mgrin nag po dang*/ de dag he ru ka ltar sgrub pa dang khro bo ltar sgrub pa sogs sgrub lugs kyi khyad par las/

grub thob rnams kyi man ngag gi sgrub thabs ni mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ da lam skabs su bab pa rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor du grags pa 'di ni/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi las rab 'byams kyi le'u las/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin ni// bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar// mda' gzhu dbyug to 'dzin pa'i mchog /rdo rje zhags pa sdigs mdzub can// spyan gsum g.yon brkyang stabs bsgom bya// zhes dang*/ rgyud phyi ma las/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin ni// khyi gdong rdo rje lha mo bzhi// bsgoms na gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i// gzi brjid rta mchog mtshungs par 'gyur// zhes gsal bar gsungs pa bzhin gyi sgrub thabs 'di ni jo bo rjes bod du dge bshes la chig brgyud du gnang ba yin zhing*/ jo bo snye thang du bzhugs skabs/ bod chos rgyal gyi blon po bran dka' dpal yon 'byung por skyes pa des tho rtsam pa'i skabs su jo bo la zhal gzigs byung bas 'di nyid jo bo'i zhal gzigs kyi sgrub thabs so zhes grags che na'ang*/ don du de ltar sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud nas 'byung ba yin cing*/ 'khor gyi shwa na ma bzhi yang khyi'i gdong can du rgyud las gsungs shing bka' gdams pa gong ma kha cig kyang de ltar bzhed do// de lta bu'i dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rgyud las gsal bar bstan pas khungs che zhing*/ jo bo chen po dang dpal karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs dam gyi lha byin rlabs dngos grub kyi tshan ka mchog tu gyur pa/ 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa/ ring brgyud ltar na sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud ltar dang*/ nye brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ dpal rta mgrin/ mnyam med dī paṃ kā ra/ nag tsho lots+tsha ba/ dge shes wal po che/ rgya lcags ri gong kha ba/ mnyam med sgam po pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ ras chen pa sogs sbyar ro// ༈ rta mgrin grub rgyal ma'i lo rgyus ni/

rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnams las rigs drug tu bshad pa'i rdo rje rgyal po ste/ don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi khro bo dpal rta yi rgyal por grags pa/ snga 'gyur bka' gter rnams las phyogs 'dir gsal zhing rgyas shos su bzhugs la/ sngar gyi gsar ma'i phyogs 'dir yang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi sogs las kyang gsungs shing*/ las kyi rigs ji bzhin par sgrub pa don yod grub pa rta yi rgyal po dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs su sgrub pa pad+ma dbang chen nam pad+ma mthar byed dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs su sgrub pa rdo rje khro bo rta mgrin nag po dang*/ de dag he ru ka ltar sgrub pa dang khro bo ltar sgrub pa sogs sgrub lugs kyi khyad par las/ grub thob rnams kyi man ngag gi sgrub thabs ni mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ da lam skabs su bab pa rta mgrin grub rgyal mar grags pa 'di ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i sras kyi thu bo ras chung rdo rje grags pa de nyid rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du lan gsum byon pa'i rjes ma la bla ma ti pu pa la lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams zhus/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i gsang yum mkha' 'gro man+dā ra ba dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i bhaṃ ga la'i phag mo'am ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo la slob dpon pad+mas gnang ba'i gdams ngag /thugs rje chen po la bsten nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i skor/ tshe dpag med la bsten nas tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i skor/ dpal rta mgrin la brten nas bar chad sel ba'i skor dang*/ shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag skor gsum bzhugs pa rnams mtha' rgyas su zhus shing*/ bod du byon nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la phul/ zangs ri ras pa sogs la gnang zhing dar rgyas su spel ba yin zhing*/ 'di dang tshe dpag grub rgyal lugs gnyis zung du sbrel ba la tshe rta zung sbrel zhes su grags pa 'di yi bla ma brgyud pa ni/

chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku dbang chen rta mgrin/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ 'gos ri khrod dbang phyug /yar lung gnyags dmar po/ rgya pho ba lung pa sogs sbyar ro// ༈ rta mgrin nag po dpa' bo lha bzhi'i lo rgyus ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnams las rigs drug tu bshad pa'i rdo rje rgyal po ste/ don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi khro bo dpal rta yi rgyal por grags pa/ snga 'gyur bka' gter rnams las phyogs 'dir gsal zhing rgyas shos su bzhugs la/ sngar gyi gsar ma'i phyogs 'dir yang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi sogs las kyang gsungs shing*/ las kyi rigs ji bzhin par sgrub pa don yod grub pa rta yi rgyal po dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs su sgrub pa pad+ma dbang chen nam pad+ma mthar byed dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs su sgrub pa rdo rje khro bo rta mgrin nag po dang*/ de dag he ru ka ltar sgrub pa dang khro bo ltar sgrub pa sogs sgrub lugs kyi khyad par las/ grub thob rnams kyi man ngag gi sgrub thabs ni mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ da lam skabs su bab pa rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can nam dpa' bo lha bzhir grags pa 'di ni/ sngags rnying ma'i nā ga klu 'dul du grags pa 'di'i sger rgyud kyang yod cing*/ sprul pa'i gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa dang gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis gter nas gdan drangs pa yin te/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter byon gyi shog ser las/ dpal rta mgrin dang rnam dbyer med pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid rgya gar lho phyogs kyi dur khrod shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nub gcig dur khrod de'i ljon shing cig la sku rgyab brten nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gnod sbyin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can zhes shin tu gdug cing rtsub pa zhig yod pa de slob dpon gyis 'dul bar dgongs nas bkug ste gu ru nyid kyi thugs ka nas dpal rta mgrin zhig spros nas gnod sbyin de'i snying khar bstims nas/

spyi gtsug tu rta mgo rkyang du thon te de ltar dam la btags nas sku'i g.yon du las mkhan gyi tshul du bzhag pa yin zhing mā ma kī la gsod byed ma lta bu gdul bya'i ming 'dul byed la thogs pa'o// de'i phyir rta nag dregs pa can sogs sngags rnying ma'i gzhung rnams nas skabs 'gar rta mgrin ma hā kā la dang*/ chos skyong gi rnam pa lta bu bstan pa yang ye shes dang 'jig rten so sor ma phye ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no// de lta bu'i khro bo rta mgrin de la yang*/ sgrub tshul gyi dbang gis/ rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo dpal rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi bka' srol 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas

sogs sbyar ro// ༈ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs la/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnams las rigs drug tu bshad pa'i rdo rje rgyal po ste/ don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi khro bo dpal rta yi rgyal por grags pa/ snga 'gyur bka' gter rnams las phyogs 'dir gsal zhing rgyas shos su bzhugs la/ sngar gyi gsar ma'i phyogs 'dir yang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi sogs las kyang gsungs shing*/ las kyi rigs ji bzhin par sgrub pa don yod grub pa rta yi rgyal po dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs su sgrub pa pad+ma dbang chen nam pad+ma mthar byed dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs su sgrub pa rdo rje khro bo rta mgrin nag po dang*/ de dag he ru ka ltar sgrub pa dang khro bo ltar sgrub pa sogs sgrub lugs kyi khyad par las/ grub thob rnams kyi man ngag gi sgrub thabs ni mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun du grags pa'i lnga pa dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po de nyid rmi lam bzung ste zangs mdog dpal rir slob dpon chen po'i drung du byon nas/ rgyal gdon gdul ba'i gnyen po rta mgrin zhig zhus pas/ gu ru nyid dpal rta mgrin gyi skur bzhengs nas rta skad lan gsum bton pas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus/ 'di'i dbang dang byin rlabs rdzogs par gnang ste slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas 'di'i chos skor rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las btus pa shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa rnams ngas gter du sbas pa snye mo nas sngags pa zhig gis gter nas spyan drangs yod pas de la zhus shig gsungs pa bzhin snye mo rgya gong ti ri pa sangs rgyas dbang chen gyis/ 'di'i chos skor rnams gter nas spyan drangs 'dug pa rnams zhus/ slar yang rmi lam bzung ste slob dpon pad+ma'i drung du byon pas slob dpon gyis da rung 'khor lo byin mi 'dug gsungs pas/

slar bla ma la rgyu mtshan zhus nas 'khor lo dang bcas pa rdzogs par zhus te/ de la rta mgrin skyer sgang pa'i lugs zhes grags so// de lta bu'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ gter ston sangs rgyas dbang chen/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po chos kyi seng ge /sangs rgyas gnyen ston/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston/ mkhas pa rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jog chen byams pa dpal bzang*/ me nyag 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rje mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ dkon mchog yan lag /karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug /lung rigs nyi ma/ karma chags med/ dul mo chos rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ zhes sogs sbyar ro// ༈ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i lo rgyus ni/ rgyud sde rin po che bzhi yod pa las rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud/ de la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su yod pa las sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa 'di pha rgyud yin cing*/ rgyud 'di slob dpon la li ta badz+ra gyis o rgyan nas spyan drangs te slob dpon dpal 'dzin la gnang ba yin/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin 'di sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma yin/ stag dang ma he dang bse ru rnams la sdigs mdzub gtad pa tsam gyis shi/ lta stangs mdzad pa tsam gyis sos pa dang*/ rgya gar lho phyogs su dge slong rtsod pa'i khyu mchog gcig yod pa/ rtsod pas yul de'i mu stegs rnams pham par mdzad nas mu stegs rnams 'grib par gyur pas/ rgyal po ha pa de bas de yi mgo bcad par brtsam pas slob dpon gyi dbu de yi bslus mar btang ste mchod sbyin gyi khang pa zhig tu ma he'i mgo zhig 'dug pa sbyar nas ma he'i zhal can du song*/

res 'ga' stag dang res 'ga' bya kaṃ ka'i dbu sogs su sprul pas thams cad ngo mtshar te phyi rol pa mang po nang pa la bkod/ sngar gyi rgyal po des slob dpon khyi yi dbu can du mthong ste/ khyi khyi zhes smras pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi sdigs mdzub gtad de/ khyod rang khyi khyi zhes gsungs pas rgyal po de skad cig tu khyir gyur pas skrag ste zhabs la btugs nas nang par gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus du ma yod cing*/ slob dpon 'di yi lugs la gshed dmar lha lnga pa dang bcu gsum ma dang gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rnams yod/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa 'di rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud yin cing*/ de yi le'u brgyad pa las/ lha mo gus dang bcas pas nyon// lha mo bdag ni mya ngan 'das// dbang po sogs kyis mi mthong ngo*// bi ru pak+ṣa rnal 'byor dbang*// bram ze'i rigs su 'byung bar 'gyur// brtson 'grus chen po stobs chen ldan// bdag gi chos rnams ston pa po// 'ga' zhig gis ni sbas pa'i rgyus// 'dis ni thob nas rab rnyed cing*// gsang sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas// bdag ni sgrub pa byed par 'gyur// 'dzam bu'i gling na sna tshogs pa'i// dngos grub rab tu ster bar byed// ces rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi ru pa chen pos lung gis bstan mod/ bu ston rin po ches 'gyur nyes mdzad pas gang yin ma shes te bi rū pa kho na mchog yin no// zhes smra ba rnams kyis kyang sngar phan rna bar ma lhung ngo*// de ltar rje btsun bi rū pa chen pos mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas rgyud 'di spyan drangs pa yin/ yang rgyud de nyid las/ kri shu bī dzoṃ yoṃ saṃ kaṃ// 'di dag bdun gyi rnal 'byor pas// nye bar dmigs par byed par 'gyur// zhes kṛṣ+ḍa pre nag po zhabs/ bī ra ḍi pa sogs lung bstan pa de gnyis la bī rū pas gnang ba yin/

spyir yang rgyud de gnyis ka nas lha lnga pa dang*/ lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis ka bstan cing*/ bī ra ḍi pas slob dpon blo gros snying po la gnang ba yin/ de nas gam+bhī ra ma ti/ biṣ+ka laṃ ka de ba la gnang ba yin/ rgyud 'di la bu ston chen pos 'gyur nyes mdzad pa la bdag gi bla mas bal yul nas rgya dpe btsal te 'gyur bcos mdzad pa yin zhing*/ paṇa chen dā na shī las g.yag sde lots+tsha ba la gnang*/ de nas lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ blo ldan seng ge bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ yang paṇa chen nyid dbang srung ba la/ chag lo tsa bas zhus/ de nas g.yung phug pa/ shangs blo ldan/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ dpal ldan seṅge/ thog ston chos kyi mnga' bdag /chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ 'jam dbyangs byang chub dbang rgyal/ shākya kun dga'/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims bkra shis/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ rje mang thos rgya mtsho/ chos grags dar rgyas/ kun spang 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ gsang dkar mkhan chen kun dga' chos 'phel/ zhes sbyar ro// ༈ mkha' 'gro ma seng gdong ma'i lo rgyus ni/ mkha' 'gro ma seng gdong ma 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i yum bcom ldan 'das ma nyid gdul bya zhi bas mi thul ba rnams la/ khro mor bzhengs pa yin te don du bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo nyid kyi sku'i bkod pa yin zhing*/ de dag gi lo rgyus zhib cing rgyas la rnam par dag pa'i khungs dang ldan pa ni snga 'gyur gyi gzhung gter byon rnams las byung zhing*/ da lam 'di nyid kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi grub thob dngul chu bai ro tsa na la gdams pa dngos su gnang*/ khong bod du byon nas gter du sbas pa zhwa nag cod paṇa 'dzin pa'i thog ma mi mchog dus gsum mkhyen pas gter nas bton te/

sgrub brgyud rin po che 'di nyid la 'gro mgon ras chen nas bzung don brgyud ltar bzhugs so// yang khams bar lam sdom tshod du sku 'khrungs pa'i ba ri lots+tsha rin chen grags rgya gar du byon/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la gtugs nas shin tu mkhas par gyur te/ mu stegs skal ldan rgyal po dang rtsod pa mdzad pas/ lots+tsha ba rgyal/ mu stegs pa pham pas/ zhag bdun na 'chi ba'i mthu byed zer ro/ der lots+tsha ba skrag nas bla ma la zhus pas/ skrag mi dgos/ rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs na/ pha wang g.yag 'dra ba'i 'og na/ bse'i ga'u zhig yod/ de'i nang na dngul gyi ga'u zhig gi nang du gser gyi yi ge 'bru bcu bzhi ma mkha' 'gro'i tshe sgrub ces kyang bya/ btsan mthu nag po zhes kyang bya/ byad ma 'bum sdug ces kyang bya/ sangs rgyas stong gi thugs bcud sngags pa phur thogs stong dang thug kyang bde mor nyal chog pa'i gdams pa yod gsungs pas/ lots+tsha bas der byon pha wang 'og nas drag sngags yi ge bcu bzhi ma bton pas/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dngos su byon nas gnang*/ lots+tsha bas sngags bgrangs/ mthu mu stegs rang la phar log nas khrag skyugs te shi/ bla ma la zhus pas/ sngags de lus la yod pas chog pa la/ bgrangs pas shi 'dug pa ma legs/ de'i sdig bshags la gser gyi gsung rab bzhengs shig gsungs/ de nas lots+tsha bas bod du bla ma sa skya pa la seng gdong ma dmar sngon gnyis kyi dbang bka' man ngag dang bcas pa tshang bar gnang nas dar ro// rje sa skya pa chen pos/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo la/ des rje btsun grags rgyal la/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rgyal/ spyan snga kun rgyal ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ steng dkar sangs rgyas chos rje/ rje ngag gi dbang po/ rin po che karma phrin las pa/ rgyal mchog karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje/

sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa rgyal ba yab sras rnams la rim par brgyud pa'o// yang paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen la rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen pos seng gdong smug nag gi sgrub thabs gnang*/ paṇa chen gyis dge mo rin chen la gnang*/ des rim bzhin/ chag lo gsum pa/ khra ri ba chen po/ lha lung rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /karma 'phrin las/ rje btsun dbyangs can dga' ba sogs nas brgyud pas paṇa chen nags rin lugs de yang 'dir 'du ba yin no// maṅga laṃ// $!#$&
